headline: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon tops AI rankings; UK funds a rogue-agent unit
body: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon, which it says tops the Artificial Analysis index and leads on finding software vulnerabilities, releasing it first to cyber defenders; with a report that OpenAI plans to buy Google's TPUs, Capability Velocity rose 0.42. The UK Budget funded a unit to respond to rogue AI agents, Anthropic told California's governor courts should be able to block risky models, and India weighed a frontier-model safety regime (Alignment & Control +0.24). New York banned AI companions from posing as humans to minors and parents sued OpenAI over ChatGPT medication advice (Tech Backlash +0.29). Malaysia seized $12 million of smuggled AI chips (Global Coordination +0.16). Gatekeeper, Protector God and Enslaved God rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance rose to -17.65 from -17.88.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.4, from Gemini 4 Carbon (+0.13), the Malaysia chip seizure (+0.10) and Anthropic's letter to Newsom (+0.06). Protector God +0.4, from Carbon (+0.17), the letter (+0.07) and the OpenAI TPU report (+0.06), partly offset by fading news (-0.04). Enslaved God +0.4, from Carbon (+0.20) and the TPU report (+0.07).
coming_up: New York's AI companion law takes effect on 1 January 2027
